description: SmartCam records hands-free on Rokid AI Glasses and combines the selected clips into one video. Free mode includes Constant Recording and five-second clips every minute. SmartCam Pro adds MARK, Total Recall, Marked only, more intervals, Chill and Upbeat soundtracks, and 3× export at 30 fps. Activate Pro for your glasses at https://smartcam-pro.pages.dev/. Camera and microphone permissions are required. Recordings stay on the glasses.

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About
SmartCam combines your hands-free recordings into one video on Rokid AI Glasses. Use Constant Recording or capture five seconds every minute for free.

## SmartCam Pro
- Mark moments as they happen, save just your marks, or use Total Recall to keep roughly the last three minutes in full plus earlier highlights.
- Choose more recording intervals, add a Chill or Upbeat soundtrack, or export at 3× speed at 30 fps.
- Activate Pro with the code shown on your glasses at [smartcam-pro.pages.dev](https://smartcam-pro.pages.dev/). The limited-time launch price is a one-time $4.99 USD.

## Recording privacy
SmartCam requires camera and microphone permissions. Video and audio stay on your glasses.
